vendor_agnostic_engine_note: VENDOR-AGNOSTIC ENGINE FRAMING (operator 2026-07-22): Handshake is a model/vendor-agnostic engine. Models are called through CLI/terminal today ONLY because Anthropic subscription plans block direct API use; Handshake is the wrapper/engine AROUND the CLI - it owns sandboxing, tool-call gating/stopping (SC MT-011), hooks (SC MT-012), cron/scheduling (SC MT-013), and exposing Handshake API/primitives to models (SC MT-014). Claude and GPT are the first two engines in the wrapper; open-source/other vendors follow. Vendor harness behaviors documented in the research basis were input, not the target; no vendor names in operator-facing surfaces, schemas, or policy vocabulary. If direct API access becomes viable, the CLI lane is swapped without touching the wrapper capabilities.
